# quickwit_field_ip (Data Source)

Builds an `ip` field mapping (IPv4 and IPv6).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Field name. Dots must be escaped (`\\.`) to be part of the name.

### Optional

- `array` (Boolean) Map an array of values (`array<T>`). Defaults to `false`.
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the field.
- `fast` (Boolean) Store the field in a columnar fast field (sorting, aggregations). Defaults to `false`.
- `indexed` (Boolean) Index the field (make it searchable). Defaults to `true`.
- `stored` (Boolean) Store the value in the doc store. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) Canonical JSON document (all defaults explicit, keys sorted), as returned by Quickwit.
